# Ken Tanaka Hernández

> Curriculum vitae and portfolio of Ken Tanaka Hernández (田中 健), a PhD researcher and HPC & AI engineer specializing in scientific computing, distributed systems, and seismic monitoring.

## Primary sources

- [Semantic CV](https://kentanaka3.github.io/): Full professional profile in static HTML, with ProfilePage and Person JSON-LD. The CV is readable without JavaScript.
- [Structured CV](https://kentanaka3.github.io/data/cv.json): Contact details, work experience, education, skills, languages, projects, publications, conferences, datasets, awards, volunteering, and interests. Dates preserve their original precision; ongoing roles and studies have a null end date.
- [PDF CV](https://kentanaka3.github.io/cv.pdf): Downloadable formatted curriculum vitae.

## Profile summary

- Current role: PhD Researcher at Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale (OGS) and Università degli Studi di Trieste (UniTS), since November 2023.
- PhD: Applied Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (ADSAI) at UniTS; in progress, with expected graduation in October 2026.
- Qualifications: Master in High Performance Computing (MHPC) at Scuola Internazionale Superiore di Studi Avanzati (SISSA) (with honors); Postgraduate Diploma in Quantitative Life Science (QLS) at the Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP); BSc. Physics at Universidad de Guadalajara (UDG).
- Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Occidente (ITESO) BEng. Nanotechnology studies were coursework only.
- Experience: Software Developer II at Oracle; modeling and numerical simulation internship at Hewlett-Packard (HP) Labs; computational physics research assistantship at UDG.
- Expertise: HPC, Big Data, distributed systems, physics-informed AI, scientific ML, data engineering, backend architecture, MLOps, parallel algorithms, and API design.
- Location: Guadalajara, Mexico. The current research role is based in Trieste, Italy.
- Contact: kentanaka3@outlook.com.

> PhD Researcher | HPC & AI Engineer | Scientific Computing

Ken Tanaka Hernández (田中 健) is a researcher with a background in physics,
mathematics, and computer science, building scalable platforms with HPC,
Big Data, and AI. His current work focuses on distributed scientific workflows,
physics-informed AI, and automated seismic monitoring.

He is a PhD Researcher at the University of Trieste (UniTS) and OGS, Italy,
since November 2023. His PhD in Applied Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
(ADSAI) is in progress, with expected graduation in October 2026. He completed
a Master in High Performance Computing (MHPC) at SISSA with honors and studied
Quantitative Life Science (QLS) at ICTP and Physics at UDG.
His BEng. Nanotechnology studies at ITESO were coursework, not a completed
degree.

Previous roles include Software Developer II at Oracle, a modeling and
numerical simulation internship at HP Labs, and a research assistantship at
UDG.
